_note: Red Alert detection thresholds. All values are configurable — change here, not in source code. Capitalized comment keys explain each threshold.

CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON._note: Performance alerts for individual territory managers and teams. Requires a target to be present (Guard 7).
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A1_THRESHOLD_NOTE: Cumulative OB / pro-rated-to-date target below this % triggers A1. 35% means running at half-speed vs the seasonal plan.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A1_SUSTAINED_NOTE: Number of consecutive complete months the achievement must stay below A1_THRESHOLD_PCT before the alert fires.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A2_NOTE: A2 fires on a single complete month with ordered_amount = 0 when plan_amount > 0. No separate threshold needed.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A3_THRESHOLD_NOTE: Target-weighted team secondary achievement below this % triggers A3.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A3_SUSTAINED_NOTE: Number of consecutive complete months the team achievement must stay below A3_THRESHOLD_PCT.

CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS._note: Alerts on individual customer / retailer behaviour. Like-months comparison only (Guard 2). Calibrated Aug 2026: retailer floor raised from ₹2 L to ₹10 L; B2 tightened from 25% to 40%; B5 code floor raised from 20 to 30; B5 drop floor raised from 50% to 60%.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B1_NOTE: Real value growth (= nominal growth minus MRP-index increase) below this % triggers B1. At ₹10 L+ retailer floor this generates ~55 alerts per full FY — within the 20-alert page cap when sorted by rupees at stake.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B2_NOTE: Nominal like-month value decline >= this % triggers B2. Raised from 25%: the 25% floor produced 87 retailer alerts in FY2025-26; 40% targets only severe sustained collapses.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B2_SUSTAINED_NOTE: B2 requires decline in the current period vs prior AND in the prior period vs prior-prior.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B3_NOTE: B3 fires when a customer has zero purchase now and non-zero in the prior comparable period. Single occurrence, no threshold.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B4_SEGMENT_FLOOR_NOTE: B4 requires the prior-period segment value to be at least this amount (₹5 L) before a segment dropout is flagged.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B4_NOTE: B4 fires when a segment bought in the prior period has zero purchase now.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B5_BREADTH_DROP_FLOOR_NOTE: Distinct item codes must drop by at least this % from prior period. Raised from 50%: a 50% drop in a 20-code basket is common seasonal variance; 60% targets structural collapse.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B5_PRIOR_CODE_FLOOR_NOTE: B5 only fires when the customer held >= this many distinct codes in the prior period. Raised from 20 to 30: ensures the breadth baseline is meaningful.

CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT._note: Territory, segment, and operational health alerts. C1/C2 require state_canon populated in sale_line_current; currently only FY2023-24 and FY2026-27 have territory rows with state_canon — older Schema-B FYs (2024-25, 2025-26) have is_territory=false and no state_canon, so C1/C2 will fire 0 for those FYs.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C1_CONCENTRATION_NOTE: A customer carrying >= this share of a state's territory value triggers concentration check.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C1_DECLINE_NOTE: The concentrated customer must decline >= this % for C1 to fire.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C2_STATE_DECLINE_NOTE: State territory value down >= this % triggers C2.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C2_SUSTAINED_NOTE: C2 requires decline in the current period AND the prior period.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C3_NOTE: A segment >= this many percentage points below the company rate (adjusted for its own seasonal position) triggers C3.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C4_NOTE: Gross contribution down >= this % while volume is up triggers C4. Only fires where factory cost (bom_cost) exists in margin_fact.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C5_NOTE: A member whose working sheet has not been successfully read for >= this many days triggers C5. The secondary sheet pipeline runs every 6 hours when the server is active, so steady-state gaps are < 1 day. 30 days catches a genuinely broken pipeline (silent for a full calendar month) without false-positives from brief server downtime or a restart. The prior value of 10 days fired for all 161 FY2026-27 members after a 26-day server-inactive gap, well above the 20-alert page cap.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C6_NOTE: Territorial concentration: a state head's territory accounts for >= C6_MIN_STOPS retailer stops AND >= C6_MIN_STOP_SHARE_PCT of all attributable stops. 'Stop' = retailer above the materiality floor (C6_MATERIALITY_FLOOR_RUPEES, same as RETAILER_RUPEES) that had non-zero prior-period purchases but zero in the current period. Denominator = all stopped retailers above floor with a resolvable state head; product-category registry rows (no hr_status AND not is_state_head) and unmapped retailers are excluded, and their rupees are NOT included in the total. Calibrated Aug 2026 at ₹10 L floor: Q1 FY2026-27 gives 66 eligible retailer stops. Sandeep Dadheech 52/66 (78.8%) fires; Syed Aqil Rizvi 10/66 (15.2%) does not. Threshold separates extreme territorial concentration from normal-level.

MATERIALITY_FLOORS._note: Minimum prior-period value for a customer to be considered for B-category alerts. Retailer floor raised from ₹2 L to ₹10 L (Aug 2026 calibration): at ₹2 L the engine produced 1,193 retailer alerts in FY2025-26 full-year; at ₹10 L the eligible pool falls to ~994 retailers and alert volume drops to a manageable level sortable by rupees at stake.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.DISTRIBUTOR_NOTE: ₹25 L prior-year territory value floor for distributor-level B alerts.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.DIRECT_DEALER_NOTE: ₹15 L prior-year territory value floor for direct-dealer-level B alerts.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.RETAILER_NOTE: ₹10 L prior-year secondary value floor for retailer-level B alerts. Raised from ₹2 L: the smaller floor covered ~2,300 eligible retailers and generated excessive noise.

GUARD_THRESHOLDS.PARTIAL_TENURE_NOTE: Members with fewer than this many working days are excluded from A-category performance alerts (Guard 8).
